title: Robustness Beyond Known Groups with Low-rank Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy (WGA) across gender subgroups, including intersections with other attributes, in facial attribute classification (CelebA), medical diagnostic imaging (CheXpert), and text toxicity detection (CivilComments).

Evaluating worst-group accuracy (WGA) across racial subgroups (e.g., Black, White) and their intersections with labels and other demographic traits in toxicity classification (CivilComments) and medical diagnostic imaging (CheXpert).
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on text toxicity classification for comments mentioning different religious groups, such as Christian and Muslim (CivilComments).
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on text toxicity classification for comments mentioning LGBTQ identities (CivilComments).

Evaluating worst-group accuracy (WGA) on subgroups defined by non-causal dataset artifacts, such as image background contexts in bird classification (Waterbirds) and the presence of negation words in natural language inference (MultiNLI).
